Royal Decor & Events — Wedding Decoration & Event Styling, Jaipur

Royal Decor & Events is a Jaipur-based decor and event-styling company offering
modern and fusion wedding setups — minimalist stage designs, themed lighting,
and contemporary floral arrangements alongside traditional options.

Note: this firm is often mistaken for "Royal Decor Studio" in Udaipur. They are
separate businesses with different ownership and different GST numbers. Please
confirm the exact company name and GST before paying any advance, as past
clients have occasionally transferred money to the wrong studio.

Pricing: standard stage + mandap packages start at ₹2,40,000; premium themed
full-venue decor runs ₹5,80,000 and up.
